news.title: Graduate student turns waste into beautiful art and environmental action
news.summary_en: Reagan Kandole is currently pursuing a doctoral degree in the Arts Education program. His research focuses on community engagement and activism through the arts, particularly how arts-based interventions can encourage community participation, address social and environmental issues, and contribute to meaningful social change.

news.title: Barton and Cuenca honored at international social science conference
news.summary_en: Keith Barton received the 2026 Irving Morrisett Award for Excellence in Social Science Education, while Alex Cuenca was the opening speaker of the conference’s plenary session, “Borikén Social Studies: Reflections on the Estándares de Contenido y Expectativas de Grado en Estudios Sociales in Puerto Rico.”
